stories.title: Sánchez califica de "tragedia social" el desahucio de Maricarmen pero descarga la responsabilidad de no evitarlo en Ayuso y Almeida

en.title: Sánchez calls Maricarmen's eviction a "social tragedy" but blames Ayuso and Almeida for failing to prevent it
en.summary: The president attributed responsibility for an eviction to regional leaders rather than confirming when his government would approve new protective measures, as it struggles to secure parliamentary support from coalition partners.

stories.title: Sánchez carga contra Ayuso y Almeida por la “tragedia social” del desahucio de Maricarmen: “Están más preocupados en comprar aticazos”

en.title: Sánchez attacks Ayuso and Almeida over the "social tragedy" of Maricarmen's eviction: "They are more concerned with buying penthouses"
en.summary: The president stated he does not rule out any measures to prevent evictions but acknowledged dependence on coalition partners who have twice rejected his protection proposal.

stories.title: Sánchez culpa a Ayuso y Almeida de la “tragedia social” del desahucio de Maricarmen

en.title: Sánchez blames Ayuso and Almeida for the "social tragedy" of Maricarmen's eviction
en.summary: Speaking from New York, the government president assigned responsibility to regional leaders for the eviction while noting Morocco's increased border control measures near Ceuta and Melilla.

stories.title: El Supremo confirma 4 años de cárcel para Santi Mina por abuso sexual

en.title: Spain's Supreme Court confirms 4-year prison sentence for Santi Mina for sexual abuse
en.summary: The Supreme Court upheld a four-year prison conviction against footballer Santiago Mina for sexual abuse of a woman that occurred in July 2017 in Almería.

stories.title: Zapatero dice al juez que las joyas son «un obsequio» que le hizo el rey de Arabia Saudí en 2007

en.title: Zapatero tells judge that jewels are a 'gift' given to him by Saudi Arabian king in 2007
en.summary: Former Spanish Prime Minister José Luis Rodríguez Zapatero claimed in court that jewels valued at 1.3 million euros found in his office were a gift from Saudi King Abdullah Bin Abdulaziz Al-Saud in 2007, according to documents in an investigation related to the Plus Ultra airline rescue.

stories.title: Harvey Weinstein es condenado a 15 años de cárcel por agresión sexual

en.title: Harvey Weinstein is sentenced to 15 years in prison for sexual assault
en.summary: A New York court sentenced former film producer Harvey Weinstein to 15 years in prison one year after he was found guilty of sexual assault charges.

stories.title: El Tribunal Supremo ratifica la condena de cuatro años de prisión a Santi Mina por abusar sexualmente de una mujer en Mojácar

en.title: The Supreme Court upholds the four-year prison sentence for Santi Mina for sexually abusing a woman in Mojácar
en.summary: Spain's highest court confirmed a four-year prison sentence against the former Valencia and Celta player for sexually abusing a woman, rejecting his claims of misinterpreting her actions.

stories.title: El Supremo confirma la condena de 4 años de cárcel para Santi Mina por abuso sexual

en.title: Supreme Court confirms 4-year prison sentence for Santi Mina for sexual abuse
en.summary: Spain's Supreme Court upheld a four-year prison conviction against footballer Santi Mina for sexual abuse. The incident allegedly occurred in July 2017 near a nightclub in Mojácar.

stories.title: El Supremo confirma cuatro años de cárcel para el futbolista Santi Mina por abuso sexual a una mujer

en.title: Supreme Court confirms four-year prison sentence for footballer Santi Mina for sexual abuse of a woman
en.summary: Spain's Supreme Court upheld a four-year prison sentence for footballer Santi Mina, rejecting his acquittal and confirming he committed two non-consensual sexual acts.

stories.title: La Audiencia Nacional absuelve al abogado de Carles Puigdemont de blanquear para 'Sito Miñanco', condenado a 17 años de cárcel

en.title: National Court acquits Carles Puigdemont's lawyer of money laundering for 'Sito Miñanco', sentenced to 17 years in prison
en.summary: The National Court acquitted lawyer Gonzalo Boye of money laundering charges. The Anti-Drug Prosecution had sought nine years and nine months imprisonment for Boye over allegations of falsifying documents related to 900,000 euros seized at Barajas.

stories.title: Zapatero sostiene que Arabia Saudí le regaló las joyas en 2007 y pide al juez que oficie una comisión rogatoria

en.title: Zapatero claims Saudi Arabia gifted him jewelry in 2007 and asks judge to issue letters rogatory
en.summary: The former Spanish president states that jewelry seized by authorities was a personal gift from Saudi Arabia and requests judicial assistance to verify this claim.

stories.title: Zapatero alega ante el juez que las joyas proceden de un regalo de Arabia Saudí

en.title: Zapatero argues before the judge that the jewels come from a Saudi Arabia gift
en.summary: The former president clarifies that jewelry was delivered in Madrid and states he accepted the gift out of deference and respect for King Abdullah Bin Abdulaziz Al-Saud.

stories.title: La IA no le quitará el trabajo, pero sí la esencia de su profesión

en.title: Artificial intelligence will not take your job away, but it will transform the essence of your profession
en.summary: While artificial intelligence may not eliminate employment opportunities, it could fundamentally alter the core aspects of professions for which workers have spent years developing exceptional skills.

stories.title: Cadenas de suministro, un punto ciego con riesgos corporativos

en.title: Supply chains, a blind spot with corporate risks
en.summary: Eight out of ten companies lack documented processes to identify and manage ESG risks from their suppliers, facing potential reputational and economic costs.

stories.title: El campo advierte al Gobierno: prorrogar las ayudas al carburante no contendrá los precios

en.title: Agricultural sector warns Government: extending fuel aid will not contain prices
en.summary: Farmers state that merely prolonging current fuel subsidies in the decree to be approved on Tuesday will not prevent prices from rising.

stories.title: Codorníu vende su bodega de California al dueño del grupo Boisset

en.title: Codorníu sells its California winery to owner of Boisset group
en.summary: Spain's leading cava producer is transferring its Napa Valley subsidiary to entrepreneur Jean-Charles Boisset.

stories.title: El Palacio de Versalles recupera la vida de una María Antonieta de cine

en.title: Palace of Versailles recovers the life of a cinematic Marie Antoinette
en.summary: Petit Trianon, the former intimate residence of France's last queen, opens an exhibition about Sofia Coppola's 2006 film, with the director's involvement.
